title: The Drive That Starts OVER 🚗
premise: On our mountain road, asking are we there yet sends the car back to mile one. My family has driven the same winter road to our rented cabin thirty-seven times, and neither my sister nor I ever asked.
twist: It was our mom: she whispers the question at the frozen waterfall every lap, with snacks packed for fifty laps, because the drive is the only time she gets both her grown kids in one car. We make her a deal, a drive a month, and then ask it ourselves, together, for one more lap.
world: A bright blue-sky winter mountain road through snowy pines in a teal minivan: a huge snowy pine, a honking orange snowplow, a frozen waterfall on a rock face, a white mile post and a little log cabin.
